title: MATERIAL SYMBOL — THE UNTETHERED TAG
creator: not declared
description:
An undeclared-author material-symbol specification for **The Untethered Tag**, designated as the canonical symbol for the Parable of Lee Sharks and Mary Lee and, more broadly, for semantic liquidation and failed indexing.

The symbol is a damaged satellite tracking tag descending through vast water while emitting a signal that reaches no receiver. Its encoded distinctions are: tag is not life, signal is not meaning, index is not ocean, and provenance can persist below capture. The document specifies form, orientation, negative space, aesthetic register, scaling, project uses, a canonical image-generation prompt, and an optional secondary Resonance Arc. It is a design brief, not a poem, empirical wildlife record, or completed visual artifact.
